description:
Reserve a single-use address to send a draft email to, for a full check.

    Returns the address and the URL its report will appear at. The address
    accepts exactly one message and expires after an hour. The email has to be
    sent by the person, from the platform or mailbox they really send from:
    half the checks read what that platform adds. The report covers 42 checks
    (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, reverse DNS, TLS, blocklists, content, links, the
    Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender rules) and a plan of what to fix.

    lang is decided now because the message arrives minutes later over SMTP,
    which carries no hint of who is waiting for it. What wait_for_report
    returns quotes check lines in English whatever it is set to; the person
    following report_url sees their own language.

include_placement.description: Also check which folder (inbox, spam, promotions) the email lands in at different mailbox providers, from the same send. The email then goes to a list of recipients instead of one address and needs a marker in the subject; both come back. Some provider inboxes are public test inboxes: the subject, the sender name and the folder are shown on a public web page, so it suits messages that are not confidential.
include_placement.title: Include Placement

lang.description: ISO code of the language the report and the fix plan are written in for the person who opens the report page, for example "en", "de" or "pt-BR". Defaults to the language of the conversation. Unknown codes fall back to English.
lang.title: Lang
